{{MapTabs|Story|Waves = No}} This page contains the official story elements included in the third mission of the [[Backyard Legends Event]]. Most of the content is expressed through cutscenes, though some dialogue is important to the storyline. {{RightTOC}} ==Story Overview== The story of this map happens after [[Competition Court]]. [[Clive]], [[Isaak]] and [[Ruthie]] talk while the match goes on in the same fashion as the previous maps. Once the final wave is over, [[Clive]], [[Isaak]] and [[Ruthie]] are standing on the court victorious over the opponent team consisting of the [[Soccer Speedy]], [[Whistle]] and [[Goal Keeper]]. The crowd is cheering while this is happening. Noticing that the opponent team is feeling down, [[Clive]] comes up to them and offers them a rematch. The [[Dispatcher]] sees this and realizes it was never about the winning. The [[Commander]] comes to a similar conclusion, but believes that it was only slightly about the winning. The match then starts, [[Isaak]] lets the ball go to [[Clive]] who kicks it towards [[Ruthie]]. She then fires the ball at the goal, ending the map's story. ==Cutscene== [[File:Adidas Event Cutscene 3|750px|thumb|center]] This cutscene plays after the final wave. The player's point of view is changed to a full screen third person view of the cutscene when it begins. ===Synopsis=== The following summarizes the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Synopsis'''
A soccer court is shown with [[Clive]], [[Ruthie]] and [[Isaak]] standing victorious over the [[Goal Keeper]], [[Soccer Speedy]] and [[Whistle]]. A crowd is then shown celebrating their victory. [[Clive]] offers the losing team a rematch. The [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] then start talking about how it was never about the winning. The rematch then starts and the players start playing against each other.
===Script=== The following is a script-based transcription of the events shown in the cutscene.
'''Script'''
[[File:AdidasMission3Ending.ogg|300px]]
''The screen shows a soccer ball court with the [[Clive]], [[Ruthie]] and [[Isaak]] standing victorious over the [[Goal Keeper]].'' ''Camera moves to the audience, showing one of them celebrating their victory.'' ''[[Clive]] notices one of the opponent's is feeling down and comes up to them.'' {{Color|Molten|Clive}}: Hey, how about a rematch? ''Camera slowly zooms out while pointed at the players, revealing the [[Commander]] and [[Dispatcher]] standing next to them.'' {{Color|Dispatcher}}: Now I think I understand. {{Color|Dispatcher}}: It wasn't about winning. {{Color|Commander}}: Never was. {{Color|Commander}}: Well, maybe a little. ''Camera now points at the soccer ball in the sky, which [[Isaak]] headbutts.'' ''[[Clive]] takes the ball and kicks it towards [[Ruthie]], who then moves with it and shoots it at the goal.'' ''Time slows down and the scene lingers on the soccer ball being close to landing in the goal before changing into a black screen..''
